C1626.title: Haidian Court Hears AI 'One-Click Undress' Obscene Materials Case
C1626.summary: Haidian Court held a first-instance hearing in Bai Moumou's case of producing and selling obscene materials for profit. Prosecutors alleged that Bai used AI 'one-click undress' technology to create more than 6,000 undressed images and generated or downloaded more than 1,500 obscene items, selling them to 351 people through QQ.
